model: Original stage-one HistGradientBoosting parameters; fit on original nine external matches only
oof: Each original test match excluded from robust fit; full-nine robust fit predicts only new SkillCorner games

candidates.robust_stage1: new stage-one probabilities, no second stage, original decoder
candidates.blend50: 0.5 * frozen v1 stacked probabilities + 0.5 * robust stage-one probabilities, original decoder

selection: Same weighted objective/gates as decoder plan. The two robust candidates compete with the nine decoder candidates. No cross-product tuning.
confirmation: One selected candidate frozen before first confirmation score; no further tuning on confirmation outcomes
input_hashes: As registered in original quality audit; raw confidential competition data excluded
